parsed.snippet:
Every RTX 4090 Owner Needs To Do This! Undervolt + Power Limit

The RTX 4090 when it comes to gaming is a crazy fast graphics card. Making 4K high refresh rate gaming a reality. However, there’s a big caveat with this graphics card, and that is its high-power draw. Out of the box the card can be seen pushing past 400W under a gaming workload.
